info.title: Notify
info.description:
Send an **ask** (a message, notification, approval or yes/no question) to enrolled **destinations** (ESP32 devices, webhooks) and get the answer back. The first answer from any destination wins.

- **Start:** `GET /api/destinations` for ids and tags, then `POST /api/asks?wait=30`.
- **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, or an OAuth token the owner approves.
- **Agent guide:** [/llms.txt](/llms.txt). **MCP:** `/mcp`. **A2A:** `/.well-known/agent-card.json`.

post.summary: Send an ask (and optionally wait for the answer)
post.description: Sends a message, notification, approval or question to destinations (ids or `tag:<tag>`). The first final answer from any of them answers it and retracts it everywhere else. With `?wait=` it holds up to 30 s for that answer: one call to ask and wait; still `open` after it means no answer yet, so wait on `GET /api/asks/{id}?wait=30`. Answers 201 with its address in `Location`. Limited to 60 per hour per API key.
